name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Images, videos, and embeds that must keep their shape.

motionProfile.reason: Aspect Ratio fades its own reserved wrapper, interpolates the one physical dimension a ratio change moved and transitions an authored wrapper surface; media decode and parent resizing keep native ownership.

enter.pop/one-shot.reason: Aspect Ratio integrates its wrapper entrance on the retained reserved host; caller media and containing regions keep their own entrances.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Aspect Ratio fades the same retained wrapper on exit without cloning media, overlays or their resources.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Aspect Ratio owns the one ratio-dependent physical axis after a committed ratio change; parent constraints and image decode stay native.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Aspect Ratio owns the wrapper surface palette it paints; descendant text and caller interactive children keep their own colour owners.
